notes: Flat statement, no hedging, reads in one beat at thumbnail size
Low-energy figure facing out of frame carries the bad-day mood without shaming
No signal element, so the type does all the work

slides.label: 01 · MOTIVATION IS WEATHER
slides.headline: Some days it shows up. Most days it does not.
slides.body:
You cannot schedule a feeling.
[[You can schedule a run.]]
Put it in the day like brushing your teeth, and let the mood turn up late.

slides.label: 02 · THE REAL QUESTION
slides.headline: Discipline is not wanting it more. It is [[needing to decide less]].
Set defaults, not intentions.
slides.body: An intention is a wish with a time on it. A default is what happens unless you stop it.

slides.label: 04 · TWO WAYS TO PLAN A WEEK
slides.headline: One asks how you feel. One does not.

left.label: MOTIVATION
left.headline: Run when you feel like it
left.body: Good weeks are great. Bad weeks vanish, and the streak goes with them.

right.label: SYSTEM
right.headline: Same days, same time, kit ready
right.body: Bad weeks get smaller runs. They still happen, so the base holds.

slides.label: 05 · THIS WEEK
slides.headline: Remove one decision.
items: Pick your run days now and write them where you will see them.
Lay your kit out the night before, shoes by the door.
Set a start time you can keep on your worst day, not your best.
On flat days, run the short version. [[It still counts.]]
